title.en: MALACAÑAN PALACE BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES ABOLISHING THE MUNICIPALITIES OF GAMAY AND LAPINIG IN THE PROVINCE OF SAMAR AND CONSOLIDATING THEIR RESPECTIVE TERRITORIES INTO AN INDEPENDENT MUNIC- IPALITY UNDER THE NAME OF LAPINIG.

text.en:
OFFICIAL GAZETTE
Gamay shall continue to be officials of the municipality of
Lapinig created by this Order.
Executive Order No. 311, dated April 30, 1950, abolishing
the municipality of Lapinig, is hereby superseded.
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of April, in
the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and fifly-one, and
of the Independence of the Philippines, the fifth.
ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
1643
By the President:
TEODORO EVANGELISTA
Executive Secretary
